title: Read query data
summary: Phoenix: Read query data. Leave out q. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: The params map includes query values. Open GET /search?q=cat.

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Read query data
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/search", LessonController, :search
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def search(conn, params), do: json(conn, %{term: Map.get(params, "q", "")})
end

blocks.text: Map.get finds q in the parameter map and returns cat.
